legitimate_temporal_change: the subject's right hand and arm rise over time
image_degradation: fine-detail softness was visible in the later sequence
geometry_identity_drift: later composition and pose were not perfectly stable; subject remained recognizable

motion_overshoot.evidence: the final hand was above the head while the requested target was approximately shoulder height

frames.evidence_method: ordered contact sheet and direct visual comparison

limitations: No quantitative image-quality metric or independent evaluator was used.
A single restored frame does not establish restoration performance across a sequence or across models.
The restoration was visually inspected against current and reference frames; this is not a pixel-identical or lossless restoration claim.
